Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game. The next game will be played on the 30th of this month and that begins at 1530 IST (1000 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Harmanpreet Kaur says she's very pleased with the performance. They have been practising well and they are confident in the shots they're playing. Mentions the bowlers were good and created opportunities which helped them build pressure.
Nigar Sultana says they were outplayed. Adds she hopes to bounce back in the next game and do well. Says they need to rotate the strike a lot more.
Renuka Singh, PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says the conditions are ere really good to bowl in and she enjoyed it. Mentions this will help them to prepare for the tournament coming up.

Bangladesh just never got going. They layer out far too many dot balls and also, the batters who got off to starts could not go onto make it big. It just kept getting difficult for them and in the end, they have fallen well short of the score.

A very convincing win for the visitors then! To be honest, we expected nothing different once they got over 140. Also, the Indian bowlers began brilliantly. They got wickets early on and that pushed Bangladesh onto the back foot. Renuka was really good and Pooja also did a good job. It was a combined effort from all the bowlers to give the Indians a convincing win.
